correctness.rationale: The sign and fixed-point-free decomposition gives S_(2p²)=C_(2p²)+p(p−1)C_(2p). The even/odd cotangent roots are governed by monic F_m in Z[1/p][Y] and monic G_m in Z[Y], so no primes other than p divide the denominator. The primitive p² roots have normalized valuations strictly greater than −2p. For primitive p roots, E(t)=B(t)+t^(p−1)/p and Newton’s log formula isolate the top j=2p+2 term: −(2p²)b2/p^(2p+2), p-adic valuation −2p and normalized coefficient −2*3^(−1), while all lower j are at least one valuation unit larger. The divisor C_(2p) contributes only an integer after multiplication by p(p−1). This is a symbolic argument for all p≥5, not extrapolation from finite p.
